Bug_Title: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in this code by not calling the'setComplete' method on the 'SessionStatus' object. Since the class is using '@SessionAttributes', it's expected that the session data will be cleaned up when the session is over. However, without calling'setComplete' on the 'SessionStatus' object, neither Spring nor the JVM knows it's time to do that.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered by not calling the setComplete() method on the SessionStatus object in the HelloWorld class. The test case testGreetMethodWithoutSetComplete() does not call setComplete(), causing the assertNull(helloWorld.getHello()) to fail, triggering the bug.
